Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - MeadowHealth (post-demo recap & next steps)

Hi Alicia — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our demo/intro call and a couple of asks so we can kick off your security review:

Summary / quick answers
- Redwood SOC 2: Type II report completed in Oct 2025 (I'll attach a redacted summary).
- HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA workloads and will execute a BAA; we have a standard template ready.
- Data residency & encryption: Customer data can be pinned to US regions; all data encrypted at rest and in transit.

Action items I promised:
1) Attach a pre-filled SIG spreadsheet for MeadowHealth to review (attached: MeadowHealth_SIG_v1.xlsx). Please confirm if you want SIG v2021.2 or CAIQ format instead.
2) Attach a redacted SOC 2 summary (redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf). Full report available under NDA.
3) Share our BAA template (attached) and a short data flow diagram; if you want, Camila can route the full SIG to our security team.

Clarifying questions for you so we scope the response correctly:
- Which SIG/CAIQ version do you need (SIG v2021.2, CAIQv3, or a custom questionnaire)?
- Do you have any custom controls or evidence formats (e.g., specific log extracts, SCIM provisioning screenshots) that we should prioritize?
- Target date for completing the vendor assessment / procurement milestone?

Next steps
- If SIG is OK, we (Camila + Security) will validate answers and return within ~5 business days for standard SIG requests.
- If you need a completed SOC 2 report or additional artifacts, we can start the NDA route — let me know and I’ll loop Legal.

Attachments: MeadowHealth_SIG_v1.xlsx; redwood_soc2_summary_2025.pdf; redwood_baa_template_v1.docx

Thanks — happy to jump back on a short follow-up call if that helps.

Jordan Blake

https://redwoodinference.com

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@meadowhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - MeadowHealth (post-demo recap & next steps)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the quick recap and attachments. A few clarifications from our side so we can confirm scope: 

1) Questionnaire format: MeadowHealth prefers SIG v2021.2 for vendor assessments. CAIQ is acceptable only if SIG is not available.
2) Evidence: our security team typically requests the data flow diagram + sample logs for auth events (redacted), and confirmation of KMS provider (do you use customer-managed keys?).
3) BAA: Procurement wants confirmation that Redwood is willing to sign a BAA; if yes, please provide your standard SLA/terms sheet for review.
4) Timeline: ideally we’d wrap the security review within 3 weeks to align with renewal planning. Can your team meet that?

One more thing — is there a named security contact at Redwood we should loop in (security@redwoodinference.com is fine, but we usually like a point person)?

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Senior IT Security Manager
MeadowHealth
Alicia.Gomez@meadowhealth.com
